purpose: Retain entity bytes from already scheduled Demo metadata GETs; no extra reads or orders.
hypothesis: Transport provenance and explicit missing Age can be retained prospectively without changing any frozen strategy or decision.
start: First process initialization at new exclusive registered path; immutable across restart.
stop: First time, count, payload, physical resource or durable storage stop; no rollover or extension.
comparison: No economic test or fill simulation; independent hash/identity/clock joins only.
unknown_age: Retain null and http_age_unknown; never infer zero or exchange freshness.
risks: Entity bytes are decoded HTTP content, not original compressed wire bytes or authenticated publication. Missing transport evidence cannot be reconstructed.
